page_title: VIL 1-1 VAL | Villarreal v Valencia 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Fran Perez (Valencia) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ricardo De Burgos didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+4' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo De Burgos ignores the protests.
90+3' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Rafa Mir (Valencia) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
87' Today's referee Ricardo De Burgos rightly decides to book Pepelu (Valencia) for his harsh tackle.

84' 1 - 1 What a finish by Umar Sadiq (Valencia)! He rises high to get to a rebound and produces a long-range header from inside the box which goes into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper was unable to stop the ball from hitting the net.
83' Pepelu (Valencia) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
81' Ayoze Perez will be replaced by Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
80' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo De Burgos no option but to blow his whistle.
77' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Valencia).
77' Alex Baena (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
76' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Pepe walks off the pitch to be replaced by Thierno Barry (Villarreal).
74' Celebrations are cut short for Villarreal as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
73' Wait! Referee Ricardo De Burgos immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
72' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
72' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
70' The percentage of ball possession is – 51:49.
67' Substitution. Diego Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
67' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Marcelino has decided to substitute Yeremy Pino and he is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
66' Substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
64' Great teamplay by Valencia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner but it's cleared.
61' Valencia fail to score from a corner as Diego Conde (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
58' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Baena (Villarreal).
55' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Umar Sadiq (Valencia) replacing Hugo Duro.
55' Substitution. Andre Almeida makes way for Ivan Jaime (Valencia).
54' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Villarreal win a corner.
52' What a chance that is! Hugo Duro (Valencia) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
51' Luis Rioja (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
48' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Jose Gaya (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Luis Rioja (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
47' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Diego Lopez (Valencia), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Ricardo De Burgos has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pepelu (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
40' Pepelu (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
37' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
32' 1 - 0 Pape Gueye (Villarreal) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
32' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Luis Rioja (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Andre Almeida (Valencia) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
28' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' The total number of attempts is 3:4.

24' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off an easy save.

23' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The linesman signals a throw-in for Valencia.

22' Luis Rioja (Valencia) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
22' Jose Gaya (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
20' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
18' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
16' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
14' Valencia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

10' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.

10' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo De Burgos with no other option than to blow for a foul.

8' Ooh that was close! Javi Guerra (Valencia) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
7' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
7' An attempted cross from Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is cleared.

4' Ambitious effort from Luis Rioja (Valencia). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Valencia will kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos was nominated as the referee for this game.
